author: RoboToolDataset
description:
ToolDEX
	

TOOLDEX is a large-scale egocentric-exocentric (ego-exo)
human demonstration dataset for creative physical tool use. It contains
episodes with different tools, objects, and actions recorded from multiple RGB
and depth cameras.

	
		
	
	
		Contents
	


Multi-view RGB and depth videos for each episode
Episode-level task, tool, action, and object metadata
Tool mesh metadata when available


	
		
	
	
		Structure
	

tasks/<task_name>/<episode_id>/<annotations or raw data>/… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/RoboToolDataset/ToolDEX-Data.
